verdict.rationale: Notte is API-first: sessions are controlled programmatically, agents start through a documented API endpoint with Bearer-token auth, and scripts deploy as invocable API functions. The same platform is also exposed through an official MCP server and CLI, so its core capabilities (browsers, agents, scraping, functions) are reachable without the UI. However, nothing in the evidence explicitly claims UI/API parity, and no OpenAPI spec was found at any probed path, so complete coverage cannot be verified. Missing for 10: an explicit UI-to-API parity statement, a published machine-readable OpenAPI spec, documented API coverage for console features such as templates, replays and credential/identity management, and independent hands-on corroboration.
